name: Starbucks
headline: Never oat drink.
tips: Never oat drink: the guide lists oats as a gluten cereal.
Any other milk is fine: skimmed, semi-skimmed, whole, almond, soya or coconut.
Swap: the drink normally comes with oat drink, so ask for another milk.
Food: almost all the bakery, breakfast and sandwiches contain wheat. Snacks and bottled drinks are where to look.
gaps: Starbucks doesn't call any drink gluten free. This app lists drinks whose ingredients contain no gluten cereals.
The drinks guide lists ingredients only. It says nothing about which drinks may contain traces of gluten.

The food guide names two products as gluten free: a granola bar made with oats, and colas made with barley malt. They're on the Avoid list here because the guide lists oats and barley as gluten cereals.
Food handled by baristas may come into contact with gluten, and the food guide says there's no guarantee any item is allergen free.
